correctness.rationale: Exact minimal DFAO: count terminal maximal digits modulo the tail-cycle of f, and distinguish any two residuals by a suffix of maximal digits. Initial state is zero-invariant. The unique possible binary mixed-incoming vertex is state 0 only if onset a=0, reached by one after p consecutive maximal digits; this gives shortest mixed path p+1. When a>0 all binary incoming edges have a unique label and opacity is zero. For b>=3 two distinct reset input symbols create a length-2 conflict. Source [1] yields normalized opacity; 4,094 independent finite configurations and 237,440 direct integer evaluations corroborate.

value.rationale: The natural valuation-controlled automatic family is fully classified for arbitrary finite output alphabets and ultimately periodic controllers. It exhibits a base-dependent three-way phase diagram and exact attainable spectrum plus sharp intrinsic state size; one transient prefix can switch the binary value from positive opacity to transparency. These facts are not a trivial renaming of any single existing example. No downstream application or complete classification of arbitrary automatic words is asserted.
